name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois discovered her passion for motorsport during a family trip to the 24 Hours of Le Mans as a child. The roar of the engines and the atmosphere of competition captivated her, setting her on a path to combine her marketing expertise with her love for racing. After graduating with a degree in marketing and communication, she started her career at a local racing team, managing their social media presence and sponsorship deals. Her dedication and creative campaigns quickly garnered attention, leading to opportunities with larger organizations. 

Sophie's approach to marketing is rooted in understanding the nuances of the motorsport fanbase and crafting authentic narratives that resonate with them. She is adept at leveraging data to optimize campaigns and ensures every marketing initiative aligns with the team's overall objectives. Known for her meticulous planning and attention to detail, Sophie strives to elevate the team's brand image and drive fan engagement. Her collaborative spirit and ability to remain composed under pressure make her a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair often pulled back into a neat ponytail during race weekends.
physical.description: Sophie is a petite woman with a focused gaze and a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down marketing ideas, even during races.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in her office.
Insists on having a specific type of French press coffee before starting any major marketing campaign.
